abstract: BACKGROUND: The intraoperative air cholangiogram, or "air leak test" (ALT), at the time of hepatectomy can significantly reduce the rates of bile leak and symptomatic fluid collection after high-risk procedures.1(,)2 Because a bile leak in the setting of an en bloc diaphragm resection and mesh reconstruction would be a particularly dreaded complication, this video shows the technique for resection, reconstruction, and ALT. PRESENTATION: The video presents the case of a 29-year-old woman who had metastatic teratoma with an 8 × 7-cm liver metastasis in segment 7 and diaphragm invasion to the level of the right hepatic vein. OPERATION: The authors performed a formal right posterior sectionectomy with en bloc diaphragm resection. The 12 × 8-cm diaphragmatic defect was reconstructed using biologic mesh (Surgimend, Integra LifeSciences, Plainsboro, NJ). An intraoperative ALT (air injection into the cystic duct with finger compression of the distal bile duct) identified several areas of bubbles from biliary radicles on the cut surface of the liver, which were ligated with 4-0 polypropylene. The ALT was repeated until no bubbles remained. Because no evidence of bubbles was observed, no surgical drain was needed. The patient did well postoperatively with no complications. CONCLUSION: In cases of combined liver and diaphragmatic resection, prevention of bile leak, with subsequent contamination of the diaphragm repair and even the thoracic cavity, is particularly vital. An easily replicated intraoperative air leak test can mitigate the risk of bile leak and organ-space infection, as well as associated sequelae on quality of life, return to intended oncologic therapy, and oncologic outcomes.
abstract_ja:
背景: 肝切除時の術中胆管造影、いわゆる「エアリークテスト(ALT)」は、高リスク手術後の胆汁漏および症候性の液体貯留の発生率を有意に低下させうる。一括横隔膜切除と메시再建を伴う場合、胆汁漏は特に恐れられる合併症となるため、本ビデオでは切除、再建、ALTの手技を示す。
提示: 本ビデオは、第7区域に8×7cmの肝転移を伴い、右肝静脈レベルまで横隔膜浸潤を認めた転移性奇形腫の29歳女性の症例を提示する。
手術: 執筆者らは、一括横隔膜切除を伴う正式な右後区域切除術を実施した。12×8cmの横隔膜欠損は生体材料メッシュ(Surgimend、Integra LifeSciences、Plainsboro、NJ)を用いて再建した。術中ALT(胆嚢管からの空気注入と遠位胆管の指による圧迫)では、肝割面の胆道枝からの気泡が複数の領域で認められ、4-0ポリプロピレンで結紮した。気泡が認められなくなるまでALTを繰り返した。気泡が認められなかったため、外科的ドレーンは不要とした。患者は術後に合併症なく経過良好であった。
結論: 肝と横隔膜の併施切除では、胆汁漏の予防、ひいては横隔膜修復部および胸腔への汚染の防止が特に重要である。容易に再現可能な術中エアリークテストは、胆汁漏および臓器-腔感染のリスク、さらに生活の質、意図した腫瘍治療への復帰、腫瘍学的転帰に関連する後遺症を軽減しうる。
